method.prompt: Run a bounded MCP integration check. Use only forge_bootstrap MCP tools; do not use shell, file, or other tools. This server uses a synthetic chooser for a disposable fixture, so no native folder dialog opens. Call plugin_status, then plugin_choose_location with mode root, then plugin_status, then list_projects, then capabilities, then plugin_reset_selection, then plugin_status. Make the actual calls and report whether all three setup tools successfully executed. Do not create projects or artwork. Stop after these checks.
method.approvals: Driver accepted only exact fixture plugin_status({}), plugin_choose_location({mode:root}) and plugin_reset_selection({}); shell/file and unrelated requests were prohibited.
method.initial_cli_attempt: All setup tools were discoverable; setup calls blocked by the noninteractive never-approval policy. Subsequent app-server turn handled exact fixture approvals.

limits: Synthetic chooser; no native dialog exercised.
Source checkout via explicit temporary MCP configuration, not an installed/frozen plugin.
